acceptanceCriteria: A CLI-level test builds a store whose journal has one record beyond the reader head and asserts the documented read and refusal behavior.
The test fails against a reader that ignores the extra record.
body:
Gap: no test drives the CLI through the case where exactly one journaled record is newer than the reader's head (one record ahead). Found in the V1-0645 lane.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
title: Missing end-to-end CLI test for a single newer journaled record ahead of the reader head
